changelog: Made installation-agnostic: env var config, install instructions, removed hardcoded paths
summary: Local speech-to-text with NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (ONNX on CPU). 30x faster than Whisper, 25 languages, auto-detection, OpenAI-compatible API. Use when transcribing audio files, converting speech to text, or processing voice recordings locally without cloud APIs.
